objective: Follow up on project progress and assess change request CR-001.
summary: The project is 38% complete, against 42% planned, with a yellow light.
The delay comes from the outdated yard system API documentation. The vendor has already sent the new version.
CR-001 proposes two Wi-Fi access points at the gate, costing +$2,500.00 with no change to the end date.
Moving the training earlier was discussed, but no decision was made.

initiatives.name: Also use digital check-in for trucks leaving the site

decisions: CR-001 approved: installation of two Wi-Fi access points, costing +$2,500.00 with no change to the end date.

actions.description: Update the charter and the schedule with CR-001
Update the status of RISK001 in the risk matrix

next_steps: Resume the discussion on moving the training earlier.
